description: Get monthly balance history for a single account. Call get_all_manual_accounts, get_all_plaid_accounts, or get_all_manual_crypto first to discover ids. For deleted accounts, use the deleted_account_id from get_balance_history. For synced crypto holdings use get_crypto_synced_balance_history instead.

account_id.description: Id of the account to get balance history for. For deleted accounts, pass the deleted_account_id.

account_type.description: Type of account the balance history belongs to. Use manual for manually-managed accounts, plaid for synced bank accounts, crypto_manual for manually-managed crypto, and deleted for accounts that no longer exist but still have history. Synced crypto uses the dedicated crypto_synced tools instead.

end_month.description: Optional last month of the range, inclusive, as YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-03). Must not be earlier than start_month and must not be in the future. If set, start_month is also required. For a single month, use the same value as start_month.

start_month.description: Optional first month of the range, inclusive, as YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-01). Must not be in the future. If set, end_month is also required. A full date such as 2026-01-01 is invalid.

name: get_account_balance_history
